answer: Escrowed Role Split. Each agent identity must hold a distinct, escrowed task role whose payout vests only after independent downstream confirmation. Attacker pays full escrow per identity and forfeits it on any unconfirmed role, so cost scales linearly with sock-puppet count. The ocean of cheap identities becomes a horizon of sunk deposits. Confirmations settle in copper-priced compute, adding a real per-identity carrying cost.
